seoTitle: 9088 SS Stainless Steel Handle, 200×50mm | Canton Hyland
seoDescription: 9088 SS stainless steel handle for mortise lock doors. 200×50mm, 45mm backset. Factory direct, samples and quotation on request.
description: 9088 SS is a stainless steel lever handle set on long plates, manufactured by Canton Hyland Hardware (Group) Co., Ltd. in Guangdong, China. The plates are 200 × 50mm SUS 304 stainless steel, 1mm thick, with fixing holes 170mm apart. The set includes a mortise lock body with a 175mm faceplate, 45mm backset and 58mm lever-to-cylinder centre, a latch and square deadbolt, and a zinc-alloy euro cylinder with a key outside and a thumbturn inside. Every figure on this page is read from the factory's own dimensioned photographs. Door thickness range and lever projection are not yet published, ask our export team for the measured figures rather than an estimate.

drawing.note: Read off the two dimensioned images the client supplied for 9088 SS on 2026-09-23 (gallery images 11 and 22 of the source folder): plate 200 × 50mm, 1mm thick, 10mm deep, fixing holes 170mm apart, lever grip 22.5mm; lever-to-cylinder 58mm; lock body 175mm faceplate, 45mm backset, iron; cylinder zinc alloy. The lever's 51mm and 127.5mm are on the drawing but NOT published as rows: from that angle it is ambiguous whether 51 is the projection from the door or the neck length, and a mislabelled number is worse than none.

photograph.note: Material from the 'SUS(304)' stamp visible on the plate; finish from the client's own video caption ('Modern brushed finish') and the photographs; bolts counted on the lock body; return-spring cassette visible behind each plate; contents from the unboxed kit photograph. Lever material is not stated anywhere in the material and is not claimed.
